title: Caramel-Churro Chex Mix
description: This churro Chex mix with caramels is full of sweet and savory flavor that will keep your party guests coming back for more this holiday season.
ingredients: 3.5 cups crispy rice cereal squares (such as Rice Chex®)
3.5 cups bite-size corn square cereal (such as Corn Chex®)
0.5 cup caramels, each unwrapped and cut into 4 pieces

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees F (135 degrees C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine rice and corn cereal squares, pretzels, and peanuts in a large bowl; stir to combine. Whisk butter, brown sugar, and vanilla together in a bowl; drizzle over cereal mixture and toss to coat.
Whisk together white sugar and cinnamon, and sprinkle over cereal mixture; toss again to thoroughly coat. Add cereal mixture to the baking sheet, and spread out evenly.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Remove from oven, and cool for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir in caramels, and store in an airtight container.
